laws.rule: In Gran Sasso and Monti della Laga National Park, free camping and bivouacking and lighting fires are banned. Camping is allowed only in set areas near towns under the park's camping regulation, with written authorisation from the relevant comune. Camper parking is banned outside towns except in permitted car parks and camper areas. Fires are allowed only at picnic areas with fire points; portable stoves and barbecues are otherwise not allowed. Visitors must stay on marked trails and take waste out. In the Comune dell'Aquila, fireworks, lanterns and barbecues are banned from 1 July to 15 September (except in equipped areas). The page lists no fines.
